forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {率|ひき}いていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to lead, to command, to head
definitions.explanation: To be at the head of a group and guide or direct them, often in an organized or official capacity.

examples.japanese: ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{率|ひき}いる。
⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧たち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{率|ひき}いて⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出場|しゅつじょう}した→出場する：20348_shutsujousuru⟧。
examples.english: The coach led the players to compete in the tournament.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{百人|ひゃくにん}→百人：10985_hyakunin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{率|ひき}いて、⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦させた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She led over a hundred subordinates and brought the big project to success.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive). Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{率|ひき}いる.

USAGE:
A formal verb used to describe leading a group of people in an organized capacity. Common with military, sports, business, and organizational contexts. Not used for casual or everyday "leading" like showing someone the way.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{率|ひき}いる: to lead a team
- ⟦{軍|ぐん}→軍：02677_gun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{率|ひき}いる: to command an army
- ⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{率|ひき}いる: to lead subordinates
- {代表団|だいひょうだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{率|ひき}いる: to head a delegation

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{導|みちび}く→導く：12361_michibiku⟧ focuses on guiding or showing the way. {率|ひき}いる emphasizes being at the head of a group and directing them as a leader.
